Subject: Q3 Phishing Simulation Campaign Results and Best Practices

Hi Everyone,

Last week the InfoSec team conducted our unannounced Q3 phishing simulation. We are pleased to report that 94% of employees either ignored or used the PhishAlarm button to report the simulated credential harvest email!

However, 14 employees entered credentials on the mock landing page. Those individuals have been automatically assigned a 10-minute refresher module on identifying lookalike domains. Remember: always inspect sender header domains and never enter your corporate password on external domains.

Stay vigilant!
[PERSON_1]
Security Awareness Team, [ORG_1]
